label: publication-full-diff-audit
command:
from pathlib import Path
import datetime, hashlib, json, plistlib, re, subprocess, tarfile, tempfile, tomllib
root=Path.cwd(); here=root/'experiments/passage-comment-geometry'; prefix=str(here.relative_to(root))+'/'
def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],text=True).strip()
base=git('rev-parse','origin/main'); ref='c20bda2dda16257164f7c584f0c5fc20a301075f'; handoff='1fa01165d2d567d0cfc26257eded29207a8d0f69'
paths=git('diff','--name-only',base).splitlines(); untracked=git('ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard').splitlines()
assert all(p.startswith(prefix) for p in paths+untracked)
assert not git('ls-files',prefix+'.vendor',prefix+'target')
implementation=[]; inventory=[]; sensitive=[]
patterns=[rb'(?:ghp_|github_pat_)[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}',rb'sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}',rb'AKIA[A-Z0-9]{16}',rb'-----BEGIN (?:RSA |OPENSSH |EC )?PRIVATE KEY-----',rb'Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._-]{20,}']
for path in paths:
    p=root/path; data=p.read_bytes()
    assert not p.is_symlink() and b'\0' not in data, path
    assert not any(part in {'.vendor','target','node_modules','__pycache__'} for part in p.relative_to(here).parts),path
    expected=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'{handoff}:{path}'])
    assert data==expected,path
    for pattern in patterns:
        if re.search(pattern,data): sensitive.append(path)
    category='evidence' if '/evidence/' in path else ('review-artifact' if '/review/' in path else 'experiment')
    inventory.append({'path':path,'bytes':len(data),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'category':category})
    if p.suffix in {'.rs','.py','.toml','.lock','.patch'} or p.name in {'.gitignore','LICENSE-TOOLKIT-APACHE'}:
        assert data==subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'{ref}:{path}']),path
        implementation.append(path)
assert not sensitive,sensitive
rp=tomllib.loads((root/'Cargo.lock').read_text())['package']; ep=tomllib.loads((here/'Cargo.lock').read_text())['package']
assert {(p['name'],p['version']) for p in ep}-{(p['name'],p['version']) for p in rp}=={('brn-passage-comment-geometry','0.1.0')}
for name,version in [('gpui-kit','0.7.3'),('gpui-base','0.7.3'),('gpui-pre','0.3.9')]:
    assert [p['version'] for p in ep if p['name']==name]==[version]
assert not any(p['name'].startswith('zorite') for p in ep)
expected=json.loads((here/'evidence/review-toolkit-sources.json').read_text()); patch=here/'patches/gpui-base-0.7.3-range-start.patch'
archive=next((Path.home()/'.cargo/registry/cache').glob('*/gpui-base-0.7.3.crate'))
assert hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='2e9955b6f4b048fd50ca15fc8e225d80bb00ba9ebc8fecdddde5ad26dbef9270'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='publication-check-',dir=here/'.vendor') as directory:
    directory=Path(directory)
    with tarfile.open(archive) as bundle:
        for path in expected:
            dest=directory/path; dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            dest.write_bytes(bundle.extractfile('gpui-base-0.7.3/'+path).read())
    subprocess.run(['patch','--batch','-p1','-i',str(patch)],cwd=directory,check=True,capture_output=True)
    for path,checksum in expected.items():
        assert hashlib.sha256((directory/path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==checksum,path
        assert hashlib.sha256((here/'.vendor/gpui-base'/path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==checksum,path
assert git('rev-parse','work/z1-zorite')=='b9bd1a14862fe2efe246790e887797c949f13c50'
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(root.parent/'z1-zorite'),'status','--porcelain'],text=True).strip()
raw=plistlib.loads(subprocess.check_output(['/usr/sbin/ioreg','-a','-n','Root','-d','1'])); roots=raw if isinstance(raw,list) else [raw]
flags=[{k:s[k] for k in ['CGSSessionScreenIsLocked'] if k in s} for r in roots for s in r.get('IOConsoleUsers',[])]
print(json.dumps({'checked_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'tested_head':git('rev-parse','HEAD'),'tested_tree':git('rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'),'publication_base':base,'reviewed_reference':ref,'handoff_reference':handoff,'full_inherited_diff_files':len(paths),'implementation_paths_byte_identical_to_review':implementation,'all_inherited_files_identical_to_handoff':True,'production_diff':[],'root_dependency_diff':[],'tracked_vendor_or_build_outputs':[],'credential_pattern_findings':sensitive,'data_origin':'source, synthetic fixtures, compiler/test output and development command metadata; no user documents or provider payloads','toolkit_patch_sha256':hashlib.sha256(patch.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'patch_reconstruction_matches_tested_sources':True,'versions':{'gpui-kit':'0.7.3','gpui-base':'0.7.3','gpui-pre':'0.3.9'},'console_session_flags':flags,'publication_scope':'experiment only; no production adoption or C-role assignment','inventory':inventory},indent=2))
